title: Earnings Announcements are Full of Surprises
one_line: The stock's abnormal return around the announcement (EARS) predicts drift better than the accounting surprise (SUE); EARS drift is larger, persists, and survived after the SUE drift shrank.

findings.statement: Return-based surprise drift larger and more persistent than SUE drift.

why.pattern: Investor under-reaction to the information in the market's own reaction.

reported_results.headline: The stock's abnormal return around the announcement (EARS) predicts drift better than the accounting surprise (SUE); EARS drift is larger, persists, and survived after the SUE drift shrank.

data_fit: Single-stock study — not testable on our ES/NQ data.
